title: Lake Erie Island Runners
specs: Explore scenic and historic Catawba Cliffs and limestone shores
Visit Put-In-Bay, Kelley's Island, Middle Bass, and Sandusky
Wildlife viewing including Snowy Egrets, Bald Eagles, Great Blue Heron
Children must be at least two years old
Life jackets must be worn by children 12 and under
includes: Complimentary soft drinks, bottled water, wine, and charcuterie board
Complimentary soft drinks, bottled water, beer and wine (21+) and snacks
Complimentary soft drinks, bottled water, wine, cocktails (21+) and charcuterie board
Life jackets provided and must be worn by children 12 and under
gap: Exact age minimum for all offerings not stated (only children must be at least two years old)
blurb: Guests cruise on boats exploring Lake Erie and its islands, enjoying scenic views, wildlife, and historic sites. Complimentary drinks and snacks are provided, with options to bring additional food and beverages (no red wine or hard liquor). Private charters and custom boating excursions are available.
extraNote: 48 hour prior notice cancellation policy · In event of bad weather, excursion can be rescheduled or fully refunded · Customer responsible for dockage fee · Hard liquor not allowed on vessels
